q: Our buyer says it will prefer lower carbon suppliers. What can we do in six months?
title: Six months to look better to a buyer
short: Start with an honest baseline from your bills, then fix the cheap things: power factor, compressed air leaks, idle running, and switching diesel generation to grid or solar where possible. Report a credible figure with evidence, plus a short plan. Buyers value proof over promises.
audience: MSME suppliers facing buyer carbon criteria

ul: Collect twelve months of electricity, fuel and production records.
Calculate CO2 per unit you sell.
Act on low-cost savings and measure them.
Ask for a green tariff or RECs if your buyer accepts them.
Send the buyer your figure, method and a one-page plan with dates.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.
